label: GOD_NAMING senses: laws, rigid equivalence, separations and joint model, checked
description: Premise-free comparison of the two GOD_NAMING senses. The rigid-designation library (TruthCore.Results.Modal.RigidDesignation.laws) is used for necessity of identity and for the equivalence of the GOD_NAMING_2 node with STMT-NECESSARY-ROOT-BOX-K; four explicit two-world separations and a joint nonvacuity model. Sense-mixing control; establishes no premise and no root obligation.
